title: Activation, Validity Period, Expiry and Cancellation of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Blocks
content:
## Activation

- A TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block whose activation basis is full payment is activated only after its block invoice has been paid in full. The evidence is the company's billing record of that block: the block invoice and the payments applied to it, read before activation.
- A block whose activation basis is signature is activated on the day its order is signed.
- Activation grants the block hours of the size.

## Expiry date

The expiry date is the day before the same day of the month that falls the size's validity months in calendar months after the activation date. When that day does not exist in the target month, the last day of the target month is used as the anniversary, and the expiry date is the day before it.

| Activation date (hypothetical) | Validity | Anniversary | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2025 | 12 months | 10 March 2026 | 9 March 2026 |
| 31 August 2025 | 6 months | 28 February 2026 (no 31 February) | 27 February 2026 |

Hours may be drawn for work performed on or before the expiry date; work on the expiry date itself may be drawn, work on the following day may not.

## After the expiry date

On the day after the expiry date a block that is still active expires and its remaining hours are forfeited, unless they were rolled into a new block; a depleted block simply stays depleted.

## Cancellation and refunds

An order may be cancelled by the client only before activation, and its block invoice is then credited in full. Once a block is activated, unused hours are never refunded or converted into credit against other services, unused hours not being refundable on any size.
